name: experience-layer-phase-1a-finding-signals
title: Experience Layer Phase 1a: finding-signals derived-cache vertical slice with gate-safe runtime-artifact registration (zero cross-module imports; cache write leaves materialHash unchanged)
description: Implement the first Experience Layer slice from docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-experience-layer-execution-plan.md: a self-contained module set (core/experience-layer-types.ts, core/learning-store.ts, core/finding-signals.ts) that derives a finding-signals cache from existing findings (read through store.readFindings, never raw findings.json), writes .lattice/learning/finding-signals.json, and registers that cache plus .lattice/learning/learning-log.jsonl in runtime-artifact-registry as materialHash:exclude/volatile so they never pollute gate freshness. Advisory-only and inert: no CLI commands, no reviewer-prompt injection, no gate logic changes. The module set keeps zero outward imports into existing core (usage-ledger isolation bar). Proven by a committed smoke that the cache write leaves currentMaterialHash unchanged.
